name: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
synopsis: Ten years after initially meeting, Anakin Skywalker shares a forbidden romance with Padmé Amidala, while Obi-Wan Kenobi discovers a secret clone army crafted for the Jedi.
cast: Hayden Christensen, Natalie Portman, Ewan McGregor
ai-tagline: Love and war ignite as darkness rises across the galaxy
ai-summary: A decade after their first encounter, Anakin Skywalker and Senator Padmé Amidala find themselves drawn into a dangerous romance forbidden by the Jedi Order. Meanwhile, Obi-Wan Kenobi uncovers a sinister plot involving a covert army of clones designed to serve the Jedi, setting the stage for an epic confrontation. As passion and conspiracy intertwine, the galaxy stands on the brink of all-out war.

name: Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi
synopsis: Rey develops her abilities with the help of Luke Skywalker as the Resistance prepares for battle against the First Order.
cast: Daisy Ridley, John Boyega, Mark Hamill
ai-tagline: The past dies. The future begins.
ai-summary: As Rey hones her Force powers under Luke Skywalker's reluctant mentorship, the Resistance mounts a desperate stand against the First Order's overwhelming forces. The galaxy's fate hangs in the balance as old heroes face their greatest trials and shocking truths emerge from the shadows of history.

name: Star Wars: Episode VII - The Force Awakens
synopsis: As a new threat to the galaxy rises, Rey, a desert scavenger, and Finn, an ex-stormtrooper, must join Han Solo and Chewbacca to search for the one hope of restoring peace.
cast: Daisy Ridley, John Boyega, Oscar Isaac
ai-tagline: The galaxy needs a hero. The past demands one.
ai-summary: When a sinister new darkness threatens the stars, an unlikely band of misfits—including a resourceful scavenger and a reformed soldier—must reunite with legendary smuggler Han Solo to confront an ancient evil. Their only chance at salvation lies in finding a legendary figure thought lost to history. As secrets unravel and the stakes grow impossibly high, they discover that destiny has a way of calling back those who tried to escape it.

name: Star Wars: Episode IX - The Rise of Skywalker
synopsis: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again.
cast: Daisy Ridley, John Boyega, Oscar Isaac
ai-tagline: The final battle for the galaxy's soul begins now
ai-summary: The Resistance makes their last stand against the First Order's overwhelming forces in an epic confrontation that will determine the fate of the entire galaxy. Rey must confront her mysterious connection to the dark side while leading the fight against tyranny. As ancient secrets unravel and unexpected allies emerge, the destiny of the Skywalker legacy hangs in the balance.

name: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
synopsis: As the Clone Wars nears its end, Obi-Wan Kenobi pursues a new threat, while Anakin Skywalker is lured by Chancellor Palpatine into a sinister plot for galactic domination.
cast: Hayden Christensen, Natalie Portman, Ewan McGregor
ai-tagline: The hero falls. The empire rises. Darkness consumes all.
ai-summary: As the galaxy's brutal conflict winds down, Anakin Skywalker becomes entangled in Chancellor Palpatine's web of manipulation, tempting him with forbidden power to save those he loves. Meanwhile, Obi-Wan confronts an emerging menace that threatens everything the Jedi have fought for. When ambition and fear overcome loyalty, the Jedi Order faces its ultimate destruction, and a dark new regime emerges from the ashes.

name: Star Wars: Episode V - The Empire Strikes Back
synopsis: After the Empire overpowers the Rebel Alliance, Luke Skywalker begins training with Jedi Master Yoda, while Darth Vader and bounty hunter Boba Fett pursue his friends across the galaxy.
cast: Mark Hamill, Harrison Ford, Carrie Fisher
ai-tagline: The dark side strikes back when heroes scatter across the stars
ai-summary: With the Rebellion in retreat, Luke seeks mystical wisdom from an ancient master while his companions flee across the cosmos, hunted relentlessly by the Empire's most feared enforcer and a ruthless mercenary on their heels. As Luke's training deepens, his friends face mounting dangers in their desperate bid to survive, unaware of the galaxy-shaking revelations awaiting them. The balance of power tips dangerously toward darkness.

name: My Neighbors the Yamadas
synopsis: The life and misadventures of a family in contemporary Japan.
cast: Yukiji Asaoka, Tôru Masuoka, Masako Araki
ai-tagline: A chaotic household finds humor in life's everyday stumbles
ai-summary: Follow the wonderfully dysfunctional Yamada family as they navigate the hilarious chaos of modern Japanese domestic life. From petty squabbles to heartfelt moments, this animated gem captures how ordinary families transform mundane routines into comedy gold. Their daily adventures remind us that imperfection and mishaps are what make a home truly special.

name: Only Yesterday
synopsis: A twenty-seven-year-old office worker travels to the countryside while reminiscing about her childhood in Tokyo.
cast: Miki Imai, Toshirô Yanagiba, Yoko Honna
ai-tagline: A woman returns to her past to discover her future.
ai-summary: When a burned-out Tokyo professional escapes to rural Japan, she finds herself transported through memories of her younger self, confronting the choices that shaped who she's become. As present and past intertwine, she must reconcile her childhood dreams with the reality of her adult life, ultimately discovering what truly matters.

name: The Wind Rises
synopsis: Jiro Horikoshi studies assiduously to fulfill his aim of becoming an aeronautical engineer. As WWII begins, fighter aircraft designed by him end up getting used by the Japanese Empire against its foes.
cast: Hideaki Anno, Miori Takimoto, Hidetoshi Nishijima
ai-tagline: One man's dream takes flight, leaving history in its wake
ai-summary: A brilliant aeronautical engineer pursues his lifelong passion for designing beautiful aircraft, unaware that his creations will become instruments of war during Japan's darkest hours. As the nation descends into conflict, Jiro must grapple with the devastating gap between his artistic vision and the brutal reality of how his work will be used. His story explores the tragic tension between personal ambition and moral responsibility during one of history's most turbulent periods.

name: Batman Begins
synopsis: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.
cast: Christian Bale, Michael Caine, Ken Watanabe
ai-tagline: One man rises from darkness to save a dying city.
ai-summary: Traumatized by his parents' murder, billionaire Bruce Wayne transforms himself into a master vigilante and returns to his corrupt hometown as the mysterious Batman. Racing against time, he uncovers a shadowy organization plotting to obliterate Gotham from within, forcing him to confront both external enemies and his own inner demons. What begins as a personal quest for justice becomes a desperate mission to save an entire city from annihilation.

name: The Queen
synopsis: After the death of Princess Diana, Queen Elizabeth II struggles with her reaction to a sequence of events nobody could have predicted.
cast: Helen Mirren, Michael Sheen, James Cromwell
ai-tagline: A nation mourns while a monarch learns to feel
ai-summary: When Princess Diana's shocking death sends shockwaves through Britain, Queen Elizabeth II finds herself at odds with public grief and modern expectations. Isolated in her palace traditions, the sovereign must navigate unprecedented pressure to demonstrate emotion and connect with a devastated nation demanding answers. Her journey becomes one of personal reckoning as she discovers what it truly means to lead with her heart.

name: Avatar
synopsis: A paraplegic Marine dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission becomes torn between following his orders and protecting the world he feels is his home.
cast: Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldaña, Sigourney Weaver
ai-tagline: One soldier. Two worlds. One impossible choice.
ai-summary: A disabled Marine is sent to an alien moon to infiltrate an indigenous civilization, but as he infiltrates their society, he discovers a profound connection to their world that forces him to betray his own kind. Caught between military duty and newfound loyalty, he must decide which side of an impending war truly deserves his allegiance. His choice will determine the fate of an entire planet.

name: Spider-Man: Homecoming
synopsis: Peter Parker tries to stop Adrian 'The Vulture' Toomes from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.
cast: Tom Holland, Michael Keaton, Robert Downey Jr.
ai-tagline: A kid in a suit learns that growing up means doing the right thing.
ai-summary: Sixteen-year-old Peter Parker juggles chemistry tests and crime-fighting when a dangerous black-market arms dealer emerges in Queens. As Spider-Man, Peter must stop the mysterious Vulture from flooding the streets with deadly alien weaponry while navigating the awkward reality of being a teenager with superpowers. His greatest challenge isn't defeating a supervillain—it's proving he's ready for the responsibility that comes with his abilities.

name: Whisper of the Heart
synopsis: A love story between a girl who loves reading books and a boy who has previously checked out all of the library books she chooses.
cast: Yoko Honna, Issei Takahashi, Takashi Tachibana
ai-tagline: Two readers discover their story was written long before they met
ai-summary: When a bookish girl notices a mysterious name repeatedly appearing in her library selections, she embarks on a quest to uncover the identity of this mysterious reader. Her investigation leads her to a charming boy who shares her passion for literature, and together they realize their lives have been mysteriously intertwined through the pages of their favorite books. What begins as curiosity blossoms into an unexpected connection that challenges them to pursue their dreams and each other.

name: Porco Rosso
synopsis: In 1930s Italy, a veteran World War I pilot is cursed to look like an anthropomorphic pig.
cast: Shûichirô Moriyama, Tokiko Katô, Bunshi Katsura VI
ai-tagline: A pig pilot fights fascists with honor and style
ai-summary: When a disgraced WWI aviator finds himself magically transformed into a swine, he embraces his new life as a freelance sky warrior in 1930s Italy. Haunted by his past and hunted by both sky pirates and fascist forces, this unlikely hero must choose between redemption and retreat. His greatest battle isn't in the clouds—it's against the darkness that shaped him.

name: Misty Green
synopsis: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.
cast: Adam Driver, Anna Kendrick, Topher Grace
ai-tagline: One comeback. One last shot. Everything to prove.
ai-summary: A once-promising actress finds herself at a crossroads when the spotlight that once defined her has dimmed to nothing. Desperate to reclaim her place in an industry that's moved on, she must navigate the messy reality of second chances and rediscover who she is beyond the roles she's played. It's a raw, funny exploration of ambition, reinvention, and what it truly means to start over.

name: Iron Man 2
synopsis: With the world now aware of his identity as Iron Man, Tony Stark must contend with both his declining health and a vengeful mad man with ties to his father's legacy.
cast: Robert Downey Jr., Mickey Rourke, Gwyneth Paltrow
ai-tagline: Power corrupts. Vengeance destroys. Only armor survives.
ai-summary: Tony Stark's superhero identity is exposed to the world, forcing him to face a dangerous adversary who exploits a deadly connection to his family's past. As his body deteriorates from the very technology keeping him alive, Stark must outmaneuver a brilliant enemy bent on revenge while battling his own mortality. The stakes have never been higher when the armor becomes both his salvation and his curse.

name: The Marvels
synopsis: Carol Danvers gets her powers entangled with those of Kamala Khan and Monica Rambeau, forcing them to work together to save the universe.
cast: Brie Larson, Teyonah Parris, Iman Vellani
ai-tagline: Three heroes, one cosmic connection, infinite power
ai-summary: When Captain Marvel's abilities mysteriously intertwine with those of two other remarkable women, the unlikely trio must learn to harness their combined strength to prevent catastrophic cosmic destruction. As they navigate their newfound connection, Carol, Kamala, and Monica discover that only by working in perfect synchronization can they hope to stop a universe-threatening force. Their journey transforms them from solo heroes into an unstoppable team.

name: The Darjeeling Limited
synopsis: A year after their father's funeral, three brothers travel across India by train in an attempt to bond with each other.
cast: Owen Wilson, Adrien Brody, Jason Schwartzman
ai-tagline: Three brothers. One train. A journey to find themselves.
ai-summary: A year of grief has passed since their father's death, and three estranged brothers embark on an unconventional pilgrimage across India aboard a crowded locomotive. What begins as a quest for spiritual healing and familial reconnection quickly devolves into comedic chaos, forcing the brothers to confront their fractured relationships and personal demons. As the train winds through the Indian landscape, they discover that sometimes the most transformative journeys happen between destinations—and between each other.

name: Captain America: Civil War
synopsis: Political involvement in the Avengers' affairs causes a rift between Captain America and Iron Man.
cast: Chris Evans, Robert Downey Jr., Scarlett Johansson
ai-tagline: Heroes divided. A nation torn. One choice changes everything.
ai-summary: When government pressure mounts to control the Avengers, Captain America and Iron Man find themselves on opposing sides of a dangerous ideological war. As their conflict escalates, the team splinters into rival factions, forcing each hero to decide between loyalty to their teammates and their personal convictions. The resulting battle threatens to destroy not just their partnership, but the entire superhero alliance itself.

name: Whiplash
synopsis: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.
cast: Miles Teller, J.K. Simmons, Melissa Benoist
ai-tagline: One man's pursuit of perfection becomes an obsession with devastating consequences
ai-summary: An ambitious drummer enters an elite music academy where he encounters a relentless conductor determined to push him toward excellence at any cost. As the line between mentorship and manipulation blurs, the young musician must decide how far he's willing to go to achieve his dreams. The two engage in a psychological battle where ambition and abuse become dangerously intertwined.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy
synopsis: A group of intergalactic criminals must pull together to stop a fanatical warrior with plans to purge the universe.
cast: Chris Pratt, Vin Diesel, Bradley Cooper
ai-tagline: Misfits. Criminals. Heroes. Save the galaxy or die trying.
ai-summary: When a ragtag band of space outlaws finds themselves the galaxy's unlikely last defense, they must overcome their selfish instincts and fractured egos to battle a ruthless zealot bent on cosmic annihilation. Paired together by circumstance and bound by necessity, these convicted rogues discover that friendship—and terrible music—might be their greatest weapon against extinction.

name: Doctor Strange
synopsis: While on a journey of physical and spiritual healing, a brilliant neurosurgeon is drawn into the world of the mystic arts.
cast: Benedict Cumberbatch, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Rachel McAdams
ai-tagline: A surgeon's hands are broken. His mind becomes his greatest weapon.
ai-summary: When a talented but arrogant neurosurgeon loses the use of his hands in a devastating accident, he embarks on a desperate quest for healing that leads him to an ancient order of sorcerers. There, he discovers that the boundaries of reality are far more fragile than science ever taught him, and that his greatest power lies not in what he can touch, but in what he can perceive. Forced to become Earth's defender against mystical forces, he must choose between returning to his old life or embracing a destiny he never imagined.

name: The Avengers
synopsis: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.
cast: Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Scarlett Johansson
ai-tagline: One team. One chance. Save the world.
ai-summary: When an otherworldly threat emerges to conquer Earth, a group of extraordinary individuals must put aside their differences and unite as a single force. As the alien invasion unfolds across the globe, these unlikely allies discover that their greatest strength lies not in their individual powers, but in their ability to work together against an enemy determined to subjugate all of humanity.

name: The Royal Tenenbaums
synopsis: The eccentric members of a dysfunctional family reluctantly gather under the same roof for various reasons.
cast: Gene Hackman, Gwyneth Paltrow, Anjelica Huston
ai-tagline: Broken geniuses find redemption in their messy, chaotic family home
ai-summary: When a con artist patriarch returns home under false pretenses, his estranged clan of former child prodigies must confront their collective disappointments and fractured bonds. What unfolds is a touching, hilarious exploration of how damaged people learn to love each other despite their spectacular failures and unresolved resentments.

name: Selma
synopsis: A chronicle of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.'s campaign to secure equal voting rights via an epic march from Selma to Montgomery, Alabama in 1965.
cast: David Oyelowo, Carmen Ejogo, Oprah Winfrey
ai-tagline: One march changed the course of American history forever
ai-summary: This powerful drama follows Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. as he orchestrates a monumental journey from Selma to Montgomery, Alabama, fighting for voting rights and challenging the systemic racism that denied Black Americans their voice. Facing violent opposition and institutional resistance, King leads thousands on a transformative march that becomes a defining moment in the Civil Rights Movement. The film captures the courage, sacrifice, and moral conviction required to reshape a nation's conscience.

name: Iron Man 3
synopsis: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.
cast: Robert Downey Jr., Guy Pearce, Gwyneth Paltrow
ai-tagline: Stark faces his greatest enemy without his armor or allies.
ai-summary: After a devastating attack shatters his life, Tony Stark embarks on a personal mission to hunt down the terrorist mastermind responsible. Stripped of his resources and forced to rely on his wits, Stark must confront an adversary more dangerous than any he's faced before, discovering that true power comes from within rather than from technology.

name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
synopsis: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.
cast: Benedict Cumberbatch, Elizabeth Olsen, Chiwetel Ejiofor
ai-tagline: One doctor. Infinite worlds. Infinite danger.
ai-summary: When a multiversal rift threatens to unravel reality itself, Doctor Strange joins forces with a young girl possessing reality-bending powers to confront twisted versions of himself across parallel dimensions. As corrupted doppelgangers from alternate universes converge on their world, Strange must navigate a maze of mystical realms and unlikely alliances—including aid from Wong and the formidable Scarlet Witch—to prevent total annihilation across all existence.

name: The Theory of Everything
synopsis: Stephen Hawking gets unprecedented success in the field of physics despite being diagnosed with motor neuron disease at the age of 21. He defeats awful odds as his first wife Jane aids him loyally.
cast: Eddie Redmayne, Felicity Jones, Tom Prior
ai-tagline: Love and equations triumph over impossible odds
ai-summary: A brilliant young physicist's meteoric rise through the scientific world is threatened when he receives a devastating diagnosis that progressively paralyzes him. With unwavering support from his devoted wife, Stephen Hawking transforms his personal struggle into extraordinary scientific achievement, proving that the human spirit transcends physical limitations. Their intimate journey becomes a testament to resilience, ambition, and the power of devotion in the face of unimaginable adversity.

name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
synopsis: With Spider-Man's identity now revealed, Peter asks Doctor Strange for help. When a spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds start to appear.
cast: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Benedict Cumberbatch
ai-tagline: One spell. Three universes. Infinite consequences.
ai-summary: When his secret identity is exposed, Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange for a magical solution—but the spell catastrophically tears open the multiverse. Now Spider-Man must face off against a deadly roster of villains from parallel worlds while desperately searching for a way to save not just his own universe, but all of reality itself.

name: Moonrise Kingdom
synopsis: Two 12-year-olds, who live on an island, fall in love with each other and elope into the wilderness. While people set out on a search mission, a violent storm approaching them catches their attention.
cast: Jared Gilman, Kara Hayward, Bruce Willis
ai-tagline: Young love runs wild when two kids vanish into the island wilderness
ai-summary: When a pair of twelve-year-old misfits discover kindred spirits in each other, they abandon their troubled lives and escape into the untamed forest. Their disappearance sets off a frantic manhunt across the island as authorities and search parties mobilize to find them. As the net closes in, a catastrophic storm threatens to upend everything, forcing the young runaways to confront both the elements and their own uncertain future.

name: Asteroid City
synopsis: World-changing events spectacularly disrupt the annual Asteroid Day celebration in an American desert town.
cast: Jason Schwartzman, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Hanks
ai-tagline: Love collides when the sky falls on a desert town
ai-summary: A quirky desert community's biggest annual event takes a chaotic turn when an unexpected celestial phenomenon crashes the party. As the town's residents—from stargazing enthusiasts to lovelorn strangers—scramble to make sense of the cosmic interruption, unexpected connections spark amid the confusion. What begins as astronomical spectacle becomes a deeply human story about finding meaning and romance in life's most unpredictable moments.

name: Boyhood
synopsis: The life of Mason, from early childhood to his arrival at college.
cast: Ellar Coltrane, Patricia Arquette, Ethan Hawke
ai-tagline: Twelve years. One boy. A life in motion.
ai-summary: Richard Linklater captures the quiet passage of time through Mason's journey from childhood wonder to the threshold of adulthood. As the years accumulate through ordinary moments and pivotal decisions, Mason navigates family dynamics, first love, and self-discovery alongside his evolving mother and sister. The film becomes a meditation on how small choices and fleeting experiences shape who we become.

name: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
synopsis: Scott Lang and Hope Van Dyne are dragged into the Quantum Realm, along with Hope's parents and Scott's daughter Cassie. Together they must find a way to escape, but what secrets is Hope's mother hiding? And who is the mysterious K...
cast: Paul Rudd, Evangeline Lilly, Michael Douglas
ai-tagline: Shrink down, gear up, save the quantum multiverse
ai-summary: When Scott Lang and Hope Van Dyne are sucked into the microscopic Quantum Realm alongside Cassie and Hope's parents, they discover a dangerous world filled with unexpected threats and shocking revelations. As they race to escape this subatomic dimension, they must confront mysterious forces and uncover the truth about Hope's mother's mysterious past. Their survival depends on teamwork, ingenuity, and mastering powers they never knew existed.

name: Ant-Man and the Wasp
synopsis: As Scott Lang balances being both a superhero and a father, Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym present an urgent new mission that finds the Ant-Man fighting alongside The Wasp to uncover secrets from their past.
cast: Paul Rudd, Evangeline Lilly, Michael Peña
ai-tagline: Tiny heroes, massive adventure, hilarious chaos
ai-summary: Scott Lang juggles fatherhood and superheroics when Hank Pym and Hope van Dyne recruit him for a dangerous mission that forces the Ant-Man to team up with the formidable Wasp. Together, they must navigate treacherous obstacles and unravel mysteries buried in their past. What ensues is a wild ride of shrinking action, witty banter, and unexpected danger.

name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
synopsis: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.
cast: Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Ebon Moss-Bachrach
ai-tagline: Family versus fate when a cosmic threat arrives on Earth
ai-summary: When a god-like entity and its mysterious messenger threaten humanity's existence, four extraordinary individuals must reconcile their personal bonds with their superhuman responsibilities. Torn between protecting the ones they love and saving the world, the Fantastic Four face their greatest challenge yet against an unstoppable celestial force. Their unity becomes their ultimate weapon in a battle that will test whether family strength can overcome universal destruction.

name: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
synopsis: The people of Wakanda fight to protect their home from intervening world powers as they mourn the death of King T'Challa.
cast: Letitia Wright, Lupita Nyong'o, Danai Gurira
ai-tagline: A nation grieves. A kingdom rises. Wakanda fights back.
ai-summary: As Wakanda reels from an unthinkable loss, the isolationist nation must defend itself against powerful global forces seeking to exploit their vulnerability and seize their resources. With their greatest protector gone, the people of Wakanda must unite and discover new strength to preserve their legacy and protect their homeland from those who would tear it apart.

name: Bottle Rocket
synopsis: Three friends plan to pull off a simple robbery and go on the run.
cast: Luke Wilson, Owen Wilson, Ned Dowd
ai-tagline: Small-time dreams, big-time consequences.
ai-summary: When an aimless young man decides to orchestrate a petty heist with his charismatic but unreliable friend, their misguided adventure spirals into an increasingly desperate fugitive lifestyle. As the two navigate life on the margins, their friendship is tested by mounting complications and the harsh reality that their amateur criminal aspirations are far messier than anticipated.

name: Thor
synopsis: The powerful but arrogant god Thor is cast out of Asgard to live amongst humans in Midgard (Earth), where he soon becomes one of their finest defenders.
cast: Chris Hemsworth, Anthony Hopkins, Natalie Portman
ai-tagline: A god learns humility when stripped of his power on Earth
ai-summary: When an arrogant deity is banished from his divine realm to Earth as punishment, he must navigate human life while discovering that true strength comes from sacrifice and compassion rather than raw power. As he adapts to his unexpected exile, he transforms from a self-absorbed warrior into humanity's unexpected protector and savior.

name: Black Widow
synopsis: Natasha Romanoff confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises.
cast: Scarlett Johansson, Florence Pugh, David Harbour
ai-tagline: She's been running from her past. Now it's time to fight back.
ai-summary: Natasha Romanoff faces a reckoning when a sinister plot connected to her shadowy past emerges from the shadows. Forced to confront the ghosts of her assassin training and the secrets she's kept buried, she must uncover the truth before her history consumes her. It's a mission that will test everything she thought she'd left behind.

name: Thor: Ragnarok
synopsis: Imprisoned on the planet Sakaar, Thor must race against time to return to Asgard and stop Ragnarök, the destruction of his world, at the hands of the powerful and ruthless villain Hela.
cast: Chris Hemsworth, Tom Hiddleston, Cate Blanchett
ai-tagline: Gods clash as the end of all things begins
ai-summary: Stranded on a hostile alien world, Thor must escape captivity and race back home to confront his sister Hela, whose apocalyptic ambitions threaten to obliterate Asgard itself. With time running out and the fabric of his realm crumbling, the God of Thunder must muster every ounce of power to prevent the prophesied destruction. It's a desperate battle between siblings as one fights for survival and the other for dominion over the cosmos.

name: Eternals
synopsis: The saga of the Eternals, a race of immortal beings who lived on Earth and shaped its history and civilizations.
cast: Gemma Chan, Richard Madden, Angelina Jolie
ai-tagline: Immortal heroes emerge from the shadows to save humanity
ai-summary: A hidden society of godlike warriors who have watched over mankind for millennia must finally abandon their non-interference policy when an ancient cosmic threat awakens. Reuniting after thousands of years apart, these powerful beings discover that their greatest challenge isn't just saving the world—it's confronting the dark secrets of their own existence. As they race against time, they must decide whether humanity is worth the price of their own unity.

name: Isle of Dogs
synopsis: Set in Japan, Isle of Dogs follows a boy's odyssey in search of his lost dog.
cast: Bryan Cranston, Koyu Rankin, Edward Norton
ai-tagline: Boy ventures to a mysterious island to rescue his beloved canine companion
ai-summary: When a young Japanese boy's faithful dog vanishes, he embarks on a daring journey to a remote, forbidden island populated entirely by pooches. Facing obstacles and unexpected allies, he must navigate this strange canine world to reunite with his cherished friend. It's a heartwarming adventure about loyalty, sacrifice, and the unbreakable bond between boy and dog.

name: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
synopsis: With a plan to exact revenge on a legendary shark that killed his partner, oceanographer Steve Zissou rallies a crew that includes his estranged wife, a journalist, and a man who may or may not be his son.
cast: Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Anjelica Huston
ai-tagline: One man. One shark. One spectacularly dysfunctional crew.
ai-summary: Driven by obsession and vengeance, eccentric oceanographer Steve Zissou assembles an unlikely team of misfits—including a rekindled romance with his ex-wife and a mysterious stranger who might be his son—to hunt down the elusive sea creature responsible for his partner's death. What unfolds is equal parts thrilling expedition and deeply personal reckoning, as Zissou discovers that the greatest discovery might be about himself.

name: Captain America: Brave New World
synopsis: Sam Wilson, the new Captain America, finds himself in the middle of an international incident and must discover the motive behind a nefarious global plan.
cast: Anthony Mackie, Harrison Ford, Danny Ramirez
ai-tagline: One shield. One mission. One chance to save the world.
ai-summary: Sam Wilson steps into the iconic suit as the new Captain America, only to be thrust into a dangerous web of international conspiracy. When a sinister scheme threatens global stability, he must race against time to uncover the shadowy forces orchestrating chaos from the shadows. With the weight of the nation on his shoulders, Sam discovers that being a hero means more than wearing the uniform.

name: Captain Marvel
synopsis: Carol Danvers becomes one of the universe's most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races.
cast: Brie Larson, Samuel L. Jackson, Ben Mendelsohn
ai-tagline: She's the universe's most powerful weapon, and she's just waking up
ai-summary: When Earth becomes a battleground in an intergalactic conflict between warring alien civilizations, a mysterious fighter pilot discovers she possesses extraordinary cosmic powers that could change the fate of worlds. Caught between two formidable forces vying for control, Carol Danvers must uncover her true identity and embrace her incredible abilities to protect humanity and restore balance to the galaxy. What she uncovers about herself will shake everything she thought she knew.

name: Spider-Man: Far from Home
synopsis: Peter Parker, the beloved superhero Spider-Man, faces four destructive elemental monsters while on holiday in Europe. Soon, he receives help from Mysterio, a fellow hero with mysterious origins.
cast: Tom Holland, Samuel L. Jackson, Jake Gyllenhaal
ai-tagline: Teen hero battles elemental chaos across Europe with a mysterious new ally
ai-summary: While trying to enjoy a European vacation, teenage Spider-Man finds himself thrust into an unexpected battle against four devastating elemental forces wreaking havoc across the continent. A enigmatic newcomer named Mysterio emerges as an unlikely partner, claiming to possess the power to stop these catastrophic threats. Together, they must determine whether this mysterious hero is truly an ally or something far more sinister.

name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
synopsis: A writer encounters the owner of an aging high-class hotel, who tells him of his early years serving as a lobby boy in the hotel's glorious years under an exceptional concierge.
cast: Ralph Fiennes, F. Murray Abraham, Mathieu Amalric
ai-tagline: Where luxury fades, friendship and memory endure forever
ai-summary: A chance meeting between a writer and the current proprietor of a once-magnificent hotel sparks a captivating tale of the man's formative years as a young lobby boy. Through his recollections, we're transported to the hotel's golden age, where he worked alongside a legendary concierge whose wit, charm, and unwavering dedication to excellence defined an era of elegance. What unfolds is a touching story about ambition, loyalty, and the bittersweet passage of time.

name: American Sniper

Armed with martial arts skills and street smarts, he races against time to shield the child from those who seek his destruction. It's a battle between light and shadow where only one can survive.

name: Saving Private Ryan
synopsis: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose comrades have been killed in action.
cast: Tom Hanks, Matt Damon, Tom Sizemore
ai-tagline: One soldier. Eight men. Impossible odds. Bring him home.
ai-summary: After the D-Day invasion, an elite squad of soldiers embarks on a desperate mission deep into Nazi-occupied France to find and extract a single paratrooper whose entire unit was wiped out. As they push forward through enemy territory, the men must confront the brutal realities of war while questioning whether one life is worth the cost of many. Their perilous journey becomes a test of courage, loyalty, and what soldiers will sacrifice for their brothers.

name: Speed
synopsis: An extortionist bomber rigs a Los Angeles city bus to explode if its speed drops below 50 mph, forcing a young cop and a female passenger to keep it moving and save everyone on board.
cast: Keanu Reeves, Dennis Hopper, Sandra Bullock
ai-summary: When a madman plants a bomb on a city bus with a deadly condition—it must maintain a speed above 50 mph or detonate—a resourceful police officer and a quick-thinking passenger must work together to keep the vehicle in motion while hunting down the terrorist. As the clock ticks and obstacles mount on Los Angeles streets, they face an impossible choice between stopping for safety or racing toward an uncertain escape. It's a high-octane battle of wits where any mistake could be catastrophic.

name: Toy Story 2
synopsis: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz and his friends set out on a rescue mission to save Woody before he becomes a museum toy property with his roundup gang Jessie, Prospector, and Bullseye.
director: John Lasseter, Ash Brannon, Lee Unkrich
cast: Tom Hanks, Tim Allen, Joan Cusack
ai-tagline: A cowboy's past catches up when a collector steals his future
ai-summary: When Woody gets snatched by an obsessive toy collector, Buzz assembles the playroom gang for a daring rescue mission across the city. Woody discovers he's part of a rare vintage collection and must reunite with long-lost cowboy companions before being locked away forever. It's a race against time as the toys learn that being played with matters more than being preserved.

name: The Firm
synopsis: A law school graduate uncovers a sinister secret about the Memphis firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.
cast: Tom Cruise, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Gene Hackman
ai-tagline: One firm. One secret. Everything to lose.
ai-summary: A promising young lawyer lands his dream job at a prestigious Memphis law firm, only to discover the organization harbors a dark criminal underworld that threatens to consume him. As he races to uncover the truth, he must navigate a deadly web of corruption while powerful forces work to silence him permanently. Caught between the mob and the FBI, he'll need to outmaneuver everyone to survive.

name: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
synopsis: Two Jedi escape a hostile blockade to find allies and come across a young boy who may bring balance to the Force, but the long-dormant Sith resurface to claim their former glory.
cast: Ewan McGregor, Liam Neeson, Natalie Portman
ai-summary: When a corrupt blockade threatens a peaceful planet, two Jedi knights flee to a distant world where they discover an extraordinary boy with an unprecedented connection to the Force. As they race to protect him and prevent catastrophe, a sinister dark force thought long extinct begins to rise, setting the stage for an epic clash between light and shadow that will reshape the galaxy forever.

name: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
synopsis: A deformed bell-ringer must assert his independence from a vicious government minister in order to help his friend, a gypsy dancer.
cast: Demi Moore, Jason Alexander, Mary Kay Bergman
ai-tagline: One soul's courage could change everything
ai-summary: Quasimodo, a kind-hearted bell-ringer hidden away in the towers of Notre Dame, breaks free from the controlling grip of a corrupt authority figure to stand up for those society has cast aside. When he befriends a spirited gypsy dancer facing persecution, he discovers that true strength comes not from physical appearance, but from the bravery to do what's right, even when the world is against you.

name: Hook
synopsis: When Captain James Hook kidnaps his children, an adult Peter Pan must return to Neverland and reclaim his youthful spirit in order to challenge his old enemy.
cast: Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts
ai-summary: A middle-aged Peter Pan faces his greatest challenge when the villainous Captain Hook abducts his children, forcing him to journey back to the magical realm of Neverland. To save them, Peter must rediscover the adventurous boy within himself and confront the dark captain who has haunted him for years. It's a battle between lost innocence and parental love.

name: Basic Instinct
synopsis: A violent police detective investigates a brutal murder that might involve a manipulative and seductive novelist.
cast: Michael Douglas, Sharon Stone, George Dzundza
ai-tagline: Desire becomes the ultimate weapon in this lethal game.
ai-summary: When a detective pursues a high-profile murder case, he finds himself dangerously drawn to the prime suspect—a brilliant and cunning author who may be using her seductive charm as the perfect cover. As the investigation intensifies, the line between hunter and hunted blurs in a psychological thriller where passion and deception are indistinguishable.

name: Ruthless People
synopsis: A couple cheated by a vile businessman kidnaps his wife in retaliation, not knowing that their enemy is delighted that they did.
director: Jim Abrahams, David Zucker, Jerry Zucker
cast: Bette Midler, Danny DeVito, Judge Reinhold
ai-tagline: Two crooks kidnap the wrong man's wife and pay the price
ai-summary: When a sleazy entrepreneur cheats a struggling couple out of their life savings, they devise what seems like the perfect revenge: kidnapping his wife. Their scheme quickly unravels when they discover the businessman actually despises his spouse and is thrilled to be rid of her, turning their leverage into a hilarious liability. As the kidnappers scramble to salvage their plan, chaos erupts on all sides.

name: The Fugitive
synopsis: Dr. Richard Kimble, unjustly accused of murdering his wife, must find the real killer while being the target of a nationwide manhunt led by a seasoned U.S. Marshal.
cast: Harrison Ford, Tommy Lee Jones, Sela Ward
ai-tagline: One man hunted. One man searching. One truth waiting.
ai-summary: Wrongly convicted of his wife's murder, Dr. Richard Kimble becomes a fugitive on the run from federal authorities, forced to navigate a deadly game of cat-and-mouse while secretly pursuing the real killer. As a relentless U.S. Marshal closes in from every direction, Kimble must stay one step ahead of the law while uncovering a conspiracy that reaches far beyond what anyone imagined. His only chance at freedom lies in proving his innocence before the manhunt catches up to him.

name: Pretty Woman
synopsis: A corporate raider hires a hooker to act as a business escort in Beverly Hills, California.
cast: Richard Gere, Julia Roberts, Jason Alexander
ai-tagline: Love blooms when a millionaire meets a woman from the streets.
ai-summary: When a wealthy businessman needs a glamorous companion for high-society events, he strikes an unlikely bargain with a spirited street hustler. What begins as a transactional arrangement transforms into genuine connection as they challenge each other's assumptions and discover unexpected depths beneath their polished and roughened surfaces.

name: The Sixth Sense
synopsis: After being shot by a resentful former patient whom he failed to help, a Philadelphia child psychologist seeks redemption by treating a young boy with a disturbing secret.
cast: Bruce Willis, Haley Joel Osment, Toni Collette
ai-tagline: A doctor's second chance comes through a boy who sees the dead
ai-summary: A traumatized psychologist discovers an unexpected path to healing when he takes on a mysterious new patient—a frightened child burdened by an unsettling ability to perceive things others cannot. As the doctor helps the boy confront his terrifying gift, he begins to uncover profound truths about loss, guilt, and the possibility of redemption. What unfolds is a haunting exploration of connection between two damaged souls seeking peace.

name: The Lion King
synopsis: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.
cast: Matthew Broderick, Jeremy Irons, James Earl Jones
ai-tagline: A prince must reclaim his destiny and avenge his father's death
ai-summary: When a young lion heir witnesses his father's tragic demise at the hands of his treacherous uncle, he flees into exile, unaware of the dark truth behind the betrayal. Years later, Simba must find the courage within himself to return home and challenge the usurper who has destroyed the kingdom. A tale of redemption, family, and the circle of life that binds them all.

name: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
synopsis: A research team is sent to the Jurassic Park Site B island to study the dinosaurs there, while an InGen team approaches with another agenda.
cast: Jeff Goldblum, Julianne Moore, Pete Postlethwaite
ai-tagline: Dinosaurs aren't extinct. They're just angrier now.
ai-summary: When a rescue mission lands on a secret island teeming with living dinosaurs, a team of scientists discovers they're not alone—and they're far from welcome. As corporate hunters arrive with sinister intentions, the researchers must navigate a treacherous landscape where humans are no longer the apex predators. Survival means outsmarting creatures that have ruled the Earth for millions of years.

name: Air Force One
synopsis: Communist radicals led by Ivan Korshunov hijack Air Force One with US President James Marshall and his family on board. Vice President Kathryn Bennett negotiates from Washington D.C., while Marshall fights to rescue the hostages o...
cast: Harrison Ford, Gary Oldman, Glenn Close
ai-tagline: When terrorists take the White House in the sky, only the President fights back.
ai-summary: A ruthless band of communist extremists seizes control of Air Force One, trapping the US President and his loved ones in a flying fortress. As negotiations stall from the ground, the Commander-in-Chief must transform from diplomat to warrior, using his wits and determination to reclaim his aircraft and save everyone aboard.

name: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
synopsis: A brash, cocky high school senior, tired of skipping school to spend a boring day at home, is determined to enjoy an epic day roaring around his favorite Chicago sites, enlisting his best friend and girlfriend to join him on the a...
cast: Matthew Broderick, Alan Ruck, Mia Sara
ai-tagline: One kid. One day. Infinite trouble.
ai-summary: A charming high school rebel orchestrates an elaborate escape from the classroom to experience Chicago's greatest attractions with his two closest friends. What begins as a simple day of hooky transforms into a wild adventure filled with narrow escapes, unforgettable moments, and the kind of freedom that can only come from breaking all the rules. As the clock ticks down to his inevitable return home, Ferris discovers that the best education isn't always found in a textbook.

name: Back to School
synopsis: To encourage his uninspired son to get through college, a wealthy and fun loving, but somewhat obnoxious, businessman decides to enter the school as a student himself.
cast: Rodney Dangerfield, Sally Kellerman, Burt Young
ai-tagline: One Dad. One Campus. Infinite Chaos and Second Chances.
ai-summary: When a brash self-made millionaire realizes his son is drifting through college unmotivated, he makes an outrageous decision to enroll alongside him. What follows is a hilarious collision of generational clash and mismatched campus life, where the father's larger-than-life personality and unconventional wisdom help both of them discover that education—and growing up—isn't just about textbooks. Together, they learn that sometimes you need to go back to school to move forward in life.

name: Revenge of the Ninja
synopsis: After ninjas killed his family, Cho and his son Kane come to America to start a new life. He opens a doll shop but is unwittingly importing heroin in the dolls. When his friend betrays him, Cho must prepare for the ultimate battle.
cast: Shô Kosugi, Keith Vitali, Virgil Frye
ai-tagline: One man. One mission. No mercy.
ai-summary: A grieving ninja master seeks peaceful refuge in America, opening an innocent doll shop to rebuild his shattered life with his son. Unbeknownst to him, his business becomes entangled in a dangerous drug smuggling operation, and when a trusted ally's betrayal threatens everything he's worked for, Cho must resurrect his lethal warrior skills for one final, explosive confrontation.

name: The Bodyguard
synopsis: A former Secret Service agent takes on the job of bodyguard to an R&B singer, whose lifestyle is most unlike a President's.
cast: Kevin Costner, Whitney Houston, Gary Kemp
ai-tagline: Love and danger collide when duty meets desire
ai-summary: When a jaded ex-agent agrees to protect a glamorous R&B superstar from an obsessed stalker, the two find themselves drawn into an intense, forbidden romance. As threats escalate and secrets unravel, he must choose between his professional obligation and his heart, all while confronting the dark forces that threaten her life.

name: Aladdin
synopsis: A kind-hearted street urchin and a power-hungry Grand Vizier vie for a magic lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.
cast: Scott Weinger, Robin Williams, Linda Larkin
ai-tagline: Three wishes. One chance. Everything changes.
ai-summary: When a charming street thief stumbles upon a mystical lamp containing an all-powerful genie, he sees his shot at a better life. But a sinister vizier will stop at nothing to claim the same prize for his own dark ambitions. In a race between good and evil, one wish might just change everything.

name: Home Alone
synopsis: An eight-year-old troublemaker, mistakenly left home alone, must defend his home against a pair of burglars on Christmas Eve.
cast: Macaulay Culkin, Joe Pesci, Daniel Stern
ai-tagline: One kid. Two crooks. Christmas chaos.
ai-summary: When a mischievous boy accidentally gets separated from his family during the holidays, he discovers he's perfectly capable of protecting his house from unwanted intruders. Armed with nothing but creativity and household items, he transforms his home into an elaborate fortress to outwit a pair of bumbling thieves. What starts as a lonely Christmas becomes an unexpected adventure in ingenuity and courage.

name: Schindler's List
synopsis: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.
cast: Liam Neeson, Ralph Fiennes, Ben Kingsley
ai-tagline: One man's conscience became a lifeline for thousands.
ai-summary: During the Nazi occupation of Poland, a pragmatic German businessman discovers his humanity while protecting his Jewish factory workers from systematic extermination. As Schindler witnesses the horrific atrocities surrounding him, his moral awakening transforms him into an unlikely savior who uses his wealth and influence to shield his employees from certain death. His extraordinary act of defiance against evil becomes a testament to the power of individual courage during history's darkest chapter.

name: The Mask
synopsis: Bank clerk Stanley Ipkiss is transformed into a manic superhero when he wears a mysterious mask.
cast: Jim Carrey, Cameron Diaz, Peter Riegert
ai-tagline: One mask. Infinite chaos. Pure comedy.
ai-summary: A meek bank employee's life explodes into glorious pandemonium when he discovers a magical artifact that unleashes his wildest, most uninhibited alter ego. Suddenly possessing cartoon-like powers and zero impulse control, he must navigate a dangerous world of criminals and corruption while barely keeping his manic green persona in check. It's a hilarious battle between mild-mannered normalcy and anarchic superpowered madness.

name: Godzilla
synopsis: Following the 1999 Janjira nuclear disaster that claimed his wife Sandra, Joe Brody seeks answers. His Navy officer son Ford accompanies him to Japan, where they discover the devastating truth and see ancient monsters emerge.
cast: Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Elizabeth Olsen, Bryan Cranston
ai-tagline: When ancient titans awaken, humanity's survival hangs in the balance
ai-summary: A father obsessed with uncovering the truth behind a catastrophic nuclear incident drags his reluctant son into a terrifying discovery—massive prehistoric creatures are awakening from their slumber. As these colossal beasts clash with modern civilization, one Navy officer must confront both his family's tragic past and the terrifying reality that humanity may be powerless against nature's ultimate predators.

name: Apollo 13
synopsis: NASA must devise a strategy to return Apollo 13 to Earth safely after the spacecraft undergoes massive internal damage putting the lives of the three astronauts on board in jeopardy.
cast: Tom Hanks, Bill Paxton, Kevin Bacon
ai-tagline: Bring them home. Houston, we have a solution.
ai-summary: When a catastrophic explosion cripples the Apollo 13 spacecraft mid-mission, NASA and its team of engineers face an impossible challenge: orchestrating an intricate rescue operation to bring three stranded astronauts back from the brink of disaster. As oxygen depletes and systems fail, the mission transforms from lunar exploration into a desperate race against time where human ingenuity and determination become humanity's only lifeline. Based on true events, this gripping account captures how ordinary people accomplished an extraordinary feat against impossible odds.

name: Armageddon
synopsis: After discovering that an asteroid the size of Texas will impact Earth in less than a month, NASA recruits a misfit team of deep-core drillers to save the planet.
cast: Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton, Ben Affleck
ai-tagline: Drill deep or die trying. The fate of humanity awaits.
ai-summary: When a catastrophic asteroid threatens to obliterate Earth, NASA makes a desperate gamble by assembling a ragtag crew of oil rig drillers to execute an impossible mission. Armed with minimal training and maximum attitude, these unlikely heroes must journey into the heart of a cosmic threat and plant explosives where no one has ever gone before. It's humanity's last stand against extinction, and the only thing standing between us and oblivion is a group of roughneck misfits who've never played by the rules.

name: Independence Day
synopsis: The aliens are coming and their goal is to invade and destroy Earth. Fighting superior technology, mankind's best weapon is the will to survive.
cast: Will Smith, Bill Pullman, Jeff Goldblum
ai-tagline: When aliens attack Earth, humanity's only hope is pure survival instinct
ai-summary: Extraterrestrial invaders descend upon Earth with overwhelming firepower and an intent to annihilate all life. Facing an enemy with vastly superior weaponry and technology, Earth's defenders must unite against impossible odds and find unconventional ways to fight back. Their greatest asset isn't military might—it's the fierce determination to protect their home and species from extinction.

name: There's Something About Mary
synopsis: A man gets a chance to meet up with his dream girl from high school, even though his date with her back then was a complete disaster.
cast: Cameron Diaz, Matt Dillon, Ben Stiller
ai-tagline: One Shot At Love Never Looked So Hilariously Messy
ai-summary: When a lovesick guy discovers his high school crush is single, he sees a golden opportunity for redemption—until his bumbling attempts to win her back spiral into absolute chaos. As he navigates a minefield of misunderstandings and romantic rivals, he learns that sometimes the path to true love requires embracing your most embarrassing, ridiculous self.

name: Forrest Gump
synopsis: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.
cast: Tom Hanks, Robin Wright, Gary Sinise
ai-summary: A simple man from Alabama witnesses and inadvertently shapes pivotal moments in American history across three decades, all while pursuing an impossible dream to reconnect with the love of his life. Despite his intellectual limitations, Forrest's unwavering optimism and pure heart carry him through extraordinary circumstances, proving that sometimes the greatest journeys come from the smallest ambitions. His extraordinary ordinary life becomes a testament to the power of persistence, kindness, and believing in tomorrow.

name: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
synopsis: Robin Hood decides to fight back as an outlaw when faced with the tyranny of the Sheriff of Nottingham.
cast: Kevin Costner, Morgan Freeman, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio
ai-tagline: One man. One bow. One chance to free England.
ai-summary: When a noble outlaw returns home to find his land seized and his people oppressed, he takes to Sherwood Forest to wage a daring war against corruption. Armed with cunning, skill, and a band of loyal rebels, Robin Hood transforms into a legendary figure of resistance against the Sheriff's cruel reign. His fight becomes not just about survival, but about reclaiming freedom for an entire nation.

name: Dances with Wolves
synopsis: A lieutenant assigned to a remote Civil War outpost starts questioning his purpose after making contact with a neighboring Sioux settlement.
cast: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell, Graham Greene
ai-tagline: One man bridged two worlds and found his true home
ai-summary: When a Union officer is stationed at an isolated frontier fort during the Civil War, he unexpectedly forms a bond with the Lakota Sioux tribe living nearby. As he immerses himself in their culture and community, he begins to question everything he's been taught about warfare, civilization, and where his loyalties truly lie. What starts as an encounter between enemies becomes a profound journey of transformation and belonging.

name: Pocahontas
synopsis: An English soldier and the daughter of an Algonquin chief share a romance when English colonists invade seventeenth century Virginia.
cast: Mel Gibson, Linda Hunt, Christian Bale
ai-tagline: Love blooms where two worlds collide in colonial America
ai-summary: When English settlers arrive in Virginia seeking fortune, a young Native American woman finds herself drawn to a compassionate soldier caught between his loyalty and his heart. As their forbidden connection deepens, both must choose between the bonds of their people and the revolutionary power of understanding one another. Their love becomes a bridge—or a battlefield—between two civilizations on an inevitable collision course.

name: Lethal Weapon 3
synopsis: Martin Riggs and Roger Murtaugh pursue a former LAPD officer who uses his knowledge of police procedure and policies to steal and sell confiscated guns and ammunition to local street gangs.
cast: Mel Gibson, Danny Glover, Joe Pesci
ai-tagline: Two Cops. One Dirty Cop. Maximum Firepower.
ai-summary: When a rogue ex-cop begins trafficking stolen police weapons to gang members across Los Angeles, detectives Riggs and Murtaugh must stop him before the city descends into chaos. The case becomes personal as they hunt someone who knows every trick in the LAPD handbook, turning their knowledge of the system into a lethal advantage. It's a high-stakes race against the clock with bullets flying and betrayal lurking within their own department.

name: Beauty and the Beast
synopsis: A prince cursed to spend his days as a hideous monster sets out to regain his humanity by earning a young woman's love.
cast: Paige O'Hara, Robby Benson, Jesse Corti
ai-tagline: Love breaks the spell that cursed a prince to darkness
ai-summary: When a young woman becomes trapped in an enchanted castle, she discovers that its terrifying Beast master is far more than his monstrous appearance suggests. As she looks past his grotesque exterior, a genuine connection blossoms between them—one powerful enough to challenge the dark magic that has held him captive. Their unlikely bond becomes the key to breaking an ancient curse and restoring what was lost to vanity and cruelty.

name: Toy Story
synopsis: A cowboy doll is profoundly jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom. When circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo have to put aside their differences to return to him.
cast: Tom Hanks, Tim Allen, Don Rickles
ai-tagline: Two rival toys learn friendship is the ultimate adventure
ai-summary: Woody the cowboy doll's world turns upside down when Buzz Lightyear, a flashy space ranger, becomes the new favorite toy in Andy's room. Jealousy and competition between the unlikely pair spiral into disaster, forcing them to work together to survive the perils outside the toy box. Through their chaotic journey back home, they discover that friendship matters more than being number one.

name: Tarzan
synopsis: A man raised by gorillas must decide where he really belongs when he discovers he is a human.
cast: Tony Goldwyn, Minnie Driver, Brian Blessed
ai-tagline: Wild heart. Human blood. One jungle. One choice.
ai-summary: A orphaned boy adopted by gorillas discovers his true human identity when explorers arrive in his forest home. Caught between two worlds, he must navigate conflicting loyalties and figure out where his heart truly belongs. His journey becomes a wild adventure that challenges everything he thought he knew about family and belonging.

name: Good Will Hunting
synopsis: A therapist counsels Will Hunting, a janitor with a genius IQ.
cast: Robin Williams, Matt Damon, Ben Affleck
ai-tagline: A brilliant mind needs healing as much as solving equations
ai-summary: When a gifted but troubled janitor catches the attention of a prestigious mathematics professor, his path toward redemption begins—but only when a compassionate therapist helps him confront the emotional wounds holding him back. As Will grapples with his extraordinary potential and deep-seated fears, he discovers that true genius lies not just in the mind, but in learning to trust and love again.

name: L.A. Confidential
synopsis: As corruption grows in 1950s Los Angeles, three policemen - one strait-laced, one brutal, and one sleazy - investigate a series of murders with their own brand of justice.
cast: Kevin Spacey, Russell Crowe, Guy Pearce
ai-tagline: Three cops. One city. No rules.
ai-summary: In a corrupt 1950s Los Angeles, three morally compromised detectives with vastly different methods find themselves entangled in a deadly murder investigation. As they pursue the case using their own twisted versions of justice, their conflicting approaches and personal demons threaten to unravel both the investigation and the city itself. Power, ambition, and buried secrets collide in this noir thriller where nobody plays by the book.

name: As Good as It Gets
synopsis: A single mother and waitress, a misanthropic author, and a gay artist form an unlikely friendship after the artist is assaulted in a robbery.
cast: Jack Nicholson, Helen Hunt, Greg Kinnear
ai-tagline: Love finds you when you stop pushing it away
ai-summary: When a brutal attack forces three lonely souls to depend on each other, an ornery novelist, a struggling waitress, and a talented painter discover that friendship—and maybe something more—can bloom in the most unexpected places. As their lives become unexpectedly intertwined, each learns that opening your heart might be the only way to truly live.

name: Anora
synopsis: A young stripper from Brooklyn meets and impulsively marries the son of a Russian oligarch. Once the news reaches Russia, her fairy tale is threatened as his parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.
cast: Mikey Madison, Paul Weissman, Lindsey Normington
ai-tagline: One wild wedding night changes everything for this Brooklyn girl
ai-summary: When a young exotic dancer from Brooklyn says "I do" to the glamorous son of a Russian billionaire, she thinks she's hit the jackpot. But her dream marriage unravels fast when his powerful parents fly into town determined to erase their son's impulsive mistake. What follows is a chaotic collision between New York grit and old-money ruthlessness that will test everything she's fighting for.

name: Titanic
synopsis: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Kate Winslet, Billy Zane
ai-tagline: Love sinks deeper than the ocean itself
ai-summary: When a young upper-class woman meets a charming penniless painter on the doomed ocean liner, she discovers a passion that transcends their worlds apart. As the ship's fate becomes sealed, their whirlwind romance becomes a desperate fight for survival and a chance at a future together. Their connection becomes the only thing that matters when faced with the Atlantic's unforgiving waters.

name: Avengers: Doomsday
synopsis: Heroes from three different worlds must unite when they're thrust together to confront a catastrophic danger that could destroy everything they know.
cast: Robert Downey Jr., Pedro Pascal, Chris Hemsworth
ai-tagline: Three worlds. One fight. Everything depends on it.
ai-summary: When a cataclysmic threat emerges that transcends dimensional boundaries, heroes from alternate realities are forced to abandon their isolation and work together for survival. As they grapple with their differences and distrust, they discover that only by combining their unique powers and perspectives can they hope to stop an apocalyptic force that threatens to annihilate all existence across every world they call home.

name: Onslaught
synopsis: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.
cast: Adria Arjona, Dan Stevens, Eric Wareheim
ai-tagline: One mother. Unstoppable killers. Desert showdown.
ai-summary: A hardened Army sniper faces her deadliest mission yet when a pack of genetically modified super-soldiers escapes into the wasteland where she's protecting her daughter. As these engineered killers close in, she must transform into something equally lethal to keep her child alive. In the unforgiving desert, there's only one rule: survive at any cost.

name: Masters of the Universe
synopsis: He-Man, the heroic defender of Castle Grayskull, battles the evil sorcerer Skeletor and his armies of darkness for control of the ultimate source of power in this classic sword-and-sorcery adventure.
cast: Dolph Lundgren, Frank Langella, Courteney Cox

name: The Punisher
synopsis: When his family is murdered by the mob, former police officer Frank Castle abandons his old identity and becomes The Punisher — a vigilante assassin who wages a relentless, violent war against the criminals responsible.

name: Animol
synopsis: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, a frightened teenager named Troy is thrust into a brutal world ruled by gangs and shifting alliances. As he navigates daily threats and an unexpected bond with a fellow inmate, a caring welfare officer tries to help him find a way back to himself before the institution's harsh hierarchy consumes him completely.
cast: Tut Nyuot, Stephen Graham, Sharon Duncan-Brewster

name: Alien
synopsis: After investigating a mysterious transmission of unknown origin, the crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform.
cast: Sigourney Weaver, Tom Skerritt, John Hurt
ai-tagline: In space, no one can hear you scream
ai-summary: When a commercial freighter responds to a distress signal in the depths of space, the crew discovers something far more sinister than a rescue mission. A parasitic creature of extraterrestrial origin stalks the darkened corridors of their ship, picking them off one by one. Trapped between the void of space and a relentless predator, survival becomes a desperate fight against an enemy they never could have anticipated.

name: Artificial
synopsis: Artificial chronicles the whirlwind days surrounding the sudden firing and reinstatement of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, exploring the clash of ambition, ideology, and power struggling for control over the technology driving the AI revolution.
cast: Andrew Garfield, Yura Borisov, Monica Barbaro

name: Mr. Irrelevant
synopsis: Mr. Irrelevant tells the inspiring true story of John Tuggle, the very last player selected in the 1983 NFL Draft, as he fights to earn a spot on the New York Giants roster against impossible odds.
cast: David Corenswet, Isabel May

name: Rocky
synopsis: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a supremely rare chance to fight the world heavyweight champion in a bout in which he strives to go the distance for his self-respect.
cast: Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire, Burt Young
ai-tagline: From the Streets to the Ring, One Man Fights for Respect
ai-summary: A gritty Philadelphia underdog boxer receives an unexpected opportunity to face the reigning heavyweight champion, transforming a shot at glory into a personal quest for dignity. Determined to prove his worth both to the world and himself, he must push past his physical limits and self-doubt. What unfolds is an inspiring tale of resilience where simply surviving the fight becomes his ultimate victory.

name: The Matrix
synopsis: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth--the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.
cast: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Carrie-Anne Moss
ai-tagline: There is no spoon, only the truth you choose to see.
ai-summary: A restless computer programmer discovers that the world he knows is an elaborate simulation designed to keep humanity docile, and that he may be the one person capable of breaking it. Guided by a group of rebels who see reality for what it truly is, he must decide whether ignorance really is bliss. What follows is a genre-defining descent into a war fought as much in the mind as in the streets.

name: Inception
synopsis: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Elliot Page
ai-tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
ai-summary: A skilled thief who invades people's dreams to steal their secrets is offered a shot at redemption: plant an idea instead of stealing one. As the job spirals through nested layers of dreams within dreams, the line between imagination and reality begins to blur dangerously. It's a heist movie unlike any other, where the vault is someone's subconscious.

name: Jaws
synopsis: When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.
cast: Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw, Richard Dreyfuss

name: Die Hard
synopsis: A New York City cop, John McClane, tries to save his estranged wife and several others taken hostage by terrorists during a Christmas Eve party at the Nakatomi Plaza Skyscraper in Los Angeles, California.
cast: Bruce Willis, Alan Rickman, Bonnie Bedelia
ai-tagline: Twelve terrorists. One cop. The odds just got even.
ai-summary: An off-duty cop faces impossible odds when terrorists seize a Los Angeles skyscraper on Christmas Eve, turning a holiday party into a pulse-pounding battle of wits and firepower. Explosive action, razor-sharp one-liners, and relentless suspense make this a high-rise thrill ride you'll never forget.

name: Total Recall
synopsis: When a man goes in to have virtual vacation memories of the planet Mars implanted in his mind, an unexpected and harrowing series of events forces him to go to the planet for real - or is he?
cast: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sharon Stone, Michael Ironside
ai-tagline: Memory is the ultimate weapon—trust no one, not even yourself.
ai-summary: A construction worker's dreams of Mars become a mind-bending reality when he uncovers a hidden past and is thrust into a high-octane battle for the fate of the Red Planet, packed with wild twists, dazzling effects, and unforgettable action.

name: Clayface
synopsis: DC Studios' Clayface reimagines the classic Gotham villain as a horror thriller, following a man whose encounter with a sinister substance transforms him into a shape-shifting monster capable of becoming anyone — or anything.
cast: Tom Rhys Harries

name: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
synopsis: A cyborg from the future, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.
cast: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, Edward Furlong
ai-tagline: He's back—and this time, the future fights for us.
ai-summary: A relentless cyborg returns from the future, this time to protect a young boy destined to change humanity's fate, unleashing groundbreaking special effects and heart-pounding action in a race against an unstoppable new enemy.

name: Resident Evil
synopsis: A special military unit fights a powerful, out-of-control supercomputer and hundreds of scientists who have mutated into flesh-eating creatures after a laboratory accident.
cast: Milla Jovovich, Michelle Rodriguez, Ryan McCluskey

name: The Girl in the River

cast: Maggie Grace, Devon Sawa, Ralph Macchio

name: RoboCop
synopsis: In a violent future in Old Detroit, murdered police officer Alex Murphy is resurrected as RoboCop, a powerful cyborg law enforcer. As he fights crime, he begins to recover memories of his past and seeks revenge on the gang who kil...
cast: Peter Weller, Nancy Allen, Dan O'Herlihy
ai-tagline: Part man, part machine, all out of time.
ai-summary: In a crime-ridden future Detroit, a mortally wounded cop is reborn as a powerful cyborg law enforcer, taking on ruthless criminals and corrupt corporations in a gritty, high-octane battle for justice.

name: Lethal Weapon
synopsis: Two newly paired cops who are complete opposites must put aside their differences in order to catch a gang of drug smugglers in Los Angeles.
cast: Mel Gibson, Danny Glover, Gary Busey
ai-tagline: Two cops. One city. Zero rules.
ai-summary: A by-the-book detective teams up with a reckless, unpredictable partner, igniting a powder keg of explosive action and razor-sharp banter as they take on L.A.'s deadliest criminals—proving that sometimes, the wildest duo gets the job done.
